title: anomaly-feed
description: I8 Anomaly Feed: cross-system CLUSTERING that no single system's health check can see - grab/import failures concentrating on one indexer (Radarr + Sonarr history pooled over 48h, since indexers are shared through Prowlarr), and incomplete downloads stalling/erroring on one tracker. Actionless v1: this contract reports, it never carries a verb. all_clear may only be true when anomalies is empty AND every checked source answered - a source that failed makes 'clear' unclaimable, and the failed source is listed rather than hidden. An empty anomalies array with a false ok somewhere is a partial read, not a green light.

detail.description: What was actually read (record counts, window size, unattributable failures) or, when ok is false, the reason the source could not be read. Never omitted in practice; the card renders it as the sources-checked note.

type.description: indexer-failures = >=4 failures in 48h AND failure share >=3x that indexer's share of attributed events. stall-cluster = >=5 incomplete downloads on one tracker host in stalledDL/error/missingFiles, or >=3 that are ALL errored/missingFiles. error-state = torrents in error/missingFiles grouped by tracker.

subject.description: Indexer name or tracker host the cluster points at.

evidence.description: The counts the verdict was computed from, in words. A card must show this - a bare 'anomaly' with no numbers is the plausible-looking lie this repo exists to prevent.
